notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Gilded Lotus to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
